facts.anchor: The vampires would need to be inside soon, but they did not appear to be in any hurry.
Night, night, witch bitch. We’ll see you in the morning, assuming you survive, of course.
She’d even managed to make friends with a rat.
Give him back! You have no right to touch him!
If they do not, we will kill you and dump your body in the river for the beasts.
We are sending his body back to Mindanforth.
I can tell you who they are and where to find them.
There is no man kinder, more loyal, more devoted.
